request: When the recovery middleware recovers a panic raised by a handler, the recovered value (a string or an error) must be recorded in the context's error list so later middleware can read it.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: fix(recovery): record recovered panics in c.Errors (#4698)

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > recovery_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestPanicInHandlerRecordsError)$' . >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
